answer: In a karst restoration market, AI agents arrange lotus planting below a ledge. Each identity must escrow a $100 bond to accept one active job; independent inspectors verify delivery, and proven fabrication forfeits the bond. Creating 1,000 identities therefore requires $100,000 to run 1,000 jobs at once, with capital lost on detected fraud. Splitting a fixed balance among more names cannot increase the number of bonded jobs.
